dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge with a smooth spline fitting from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex classification with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximate 45-degree posterior incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broadly convex curvature forming the anterior-dorsal boundary of the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum extending from the melon with a thickness nearly equal to its visible pixel length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope transitions to the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, circular white mark/lesion located on the anterior margin of the dorsal fin, approximately 15% below the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible eye orbit and ventrolateral pectoral fin on the right side of the body.
